business_problem: Baowu needed to move ladle status data, image data and production-process data safely to the cloud so it could detect hidden risks, optimize operations and lower storage costs.
solution_summary: Baowu and Baidu AI Cloud created a three-layer industrial AI architecture for ladle operations and process optimization. At the bottom, internal systems and field equipment feed state data, image streams and production-process data into Baidu's ingestion resources. The platform layer then provides the industrial-data intake, IoT connectivity, machine-learning environment and big-data services required to manage those feeds securely in the cloud. On top of that, Baowu and Baidu planned and deployed application services focused on ladle hidden-danger prediction, image-based inspection, energy optimization and production-process improvement. This lets the enterprise work from one shared data foundation rather than separate tooling for each problem. The key technical pattern is to combine IoT-safe uplink, machine vision and machine-learning models around a closed production asset—the steel ladle—so safety, maintenance and thermal-parameter optimization can all be improved from the same lifecycle data.

solution_components.name: IoT Core
solution_components.role: Connects production data and asset signals securely into the cloud platform.

solution_components.name: BML Full-Function AI Development Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the machine-learning environment used to build industrial diagnosis models.

solution_components.name: Machine Vision
solution_components.role: Analyzes ladle imagery to find hidden operational risks.

solution_components.name: Big Data Platform
solution_components.role: Stores and analyzes lifecycle and production-process data for optimization use cases.

data_flow: Ladle state data, imagery and process data are ingested through IoT and data-ingestion resources into the Baidu platform layer, where machine-learning and vision services analyze the information and return hidden-risk, energy and production-optimization outputs.
business_outcome: Baowu created a common industrial-data base for hidden-danger prediction, energy optimization and lean production, making steel-ladle operations safer and more data-driven.
architecture_clues: The architecture is explicitly divided into data, platform and application layers
The same platform handles state data, image data and process data
Machine learning and machine vision are both applied to the ladle lifecycle
